title: Time-Range Log Queries with Streaming Results
prompt:
Implement `LogStore`. `add(timestamp, message)` accepts an integer timestamp and a string message; arrivals may be out of timestamp order. `iter_range(start, end)` returns a fresh iterator of `(timestamp, message)` pairs for the closed interval `[start, end]`. Results must be ordered by timestamp, and records with equal timestamps must retain insertion order.

Locate a query range in O(log n) time and yield matching records lazily. `start` and `end` must be integers with `start <= end`; reject invalid arguments with an error. The exercise is single-threaded: concurrent writes during iteration are out of scope.

Invalid inputs may be rejected with `assert`.

example.reasoning: Out-of-order ingestion is normalized at query time, and both query boundaries are inclusive.
